_comment: Values that are not one CSS variable: read from the real elements in the signed-in copies (raw/layout.json and raw/components-computed.json). Every leaf names where it was read. Colours are hex or rgba(); shadows are written layer by layer as the computed box-shadow listed them, with the transparent Tailwind ring placeholders dropped.

sidebar-width.source: measured: aside.dframe-sidebar on every desktop copy (layout.json); also --df-sidebar-width

sidebar-gap.source: measured: the content pane starts at x 296, 8 past the sidebar (.dframe-pane-primary, layout.json)

header-height.source: measured: header.dframe-header and the chat header (h-12); also --df-header-h

sidebar-titlebar-height.source: measured: the sidebar's .df-titlebar (h-11) holding the wordmark, Hide sidebar and Search

transcript-feed-width.source: measured: [role=feed] inside the transcript list, 16px in from each side

composer-width-home.source: measured: the home composer (max-w-2xl, 672 at 1440 wide, layout.json)

composer-width-thread.source: measured: the composer dock on a chat, the transcript width

page-width.source: measured: the PageHeader and list column of Artifacts, Chats and Projects (layout.json page.header.w)

list-row-height.source: measured: an Artifacts list row (li.group/cdsrow, pitch 52)

table-row-height.source: measured: a Chats list table row (tr.group/cdsrow, 53 with its hairline)

project-rail-width.source: measured: the project page's right rail of cards (Instructions, Memory, Context)

phone-width.source: the phone captures; the drawer is a full-width sheet

composer.source: measured: the composer card, rounded-[20px] (12px, rounded-xl, at compact density); not --cds-radius-composer, which the template cards use

card.source: measured: menus, dialogs, the notice card, project cards (rounded-card: --cds-radius + 4px)

row.source: measured: sidebar rows (--df-radius-pill), menu items, icon buttons, list row hover fills, code blocks

segment-track.source: measured: the Chat/Cowork and Home/Code tracks (--cds-radius - 1px)

segment-thumb.source: measured: the segmented control thumb and the sidebar mode pill

template-card.source: measured: the Make something new tiles (rounded-composer, --cds-radius-composer)

rail-card.source: measured: the project page's Instructions card (rounded-2xl)

icon-button.source: measured: header, composer and sidebar title icon buttons (cds Button, h-control at comfortable)

icon-button-small.source: measured: the row action buttons in the sidebar (--df-row-ctl)

sidebar-row.source: measured: sidebar nav and chat rows (--df-row-h, comfortable web)

menu-row-two-line.source: measured: a model menu item with its description

avatar.source: measured: the account avatar (--cds-avatar-sm at comfortable)

mode-pill-height.source: measured: the sidebar Home/Code pills inside a 32px track

nav-glyph.source: measured: sidebar row glyphs (--df-icon-size) in a 28px leading slot

chat-bullet.source: measured: the hollow ring in front of each chat row (size-[6px], 1px border)

display-size.source: measured: the home greeting at 1440 wide (--new-page-greeting-font-size clamp(1.875rem, 1.2rem + 2vw, 2.375rem)); 30 at 390 wide

chat-size.source: measured: assistant paragraphs and table cells (.font-claude-response-body, Anthropic Serif 16/24)

user-message-size.source: measured: user message paragraphs (text-heading: --cds-font-size-heading at comfortable)

composer-size.source: measured: the composer placeholder and typed text (font-large)

sidebar-bg.source: measured: aside.dframe-sidebar background (light reading); --df-web-sidebar-bg resolves to #fbfbf9, the difference is color-mix rounding

composer-shadow.source: measured: composer box-shadow at rest (shadow-composer: a soft drop and an outset 1px ring of --cds-border, since --cds-ring-outer is 1px in light)

composer-shadow-focus.source: measured: composer focus-within (shadow-composer-focus: the ring turns --cds-border-strong)

dialog-shadow.source: measured: the settings dialog (the ring plus --cds-shadow-sm)

mode-pill-indicator-shadow.source: measured: .df-pill-indicator under the active Home/Code pill

sidebar-bg.source: measured: aside.dframe-sidebar background (dark reading); --df-web-sidebar-bg, color-mix(in srgb, --df-bg-page 80%, black)

composer-shadow.source: measured: composer box-shadow at rest; in dark the 1px ring is inset (--cds-ring-inner 1px, --cds-ring-outer 0)
